fact: The World Bank ISR (archived 26 Nov 2025) says the contract for the Integrated Tax Administration System was signed after the September 2025 mid-term review, with online filing by large taxpayers still at 0% awaiting ITAS implementation.
An opinion piece by Adan Omar Hashi says rollout of the ITAS tax platform, covering registration, filing and payment, is due to begin at the end of 2026 and run into 2027.
